Samuel R. Delany, The Jewels of Aptor.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/samuel-r-delany/the-jewels-of-aptor

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Samuel R. Delany, the author. The facts file gives no death date (Wikidata Q438164). This does not change the decision, because the text's origin is the United States (see below).

First publication of the text used: 1962 (SE colophon: 'The Jewels of Aptor was published in 1962 by Samuel R. Delany'; Wikipedia: publisher Ace Books, publication place United States, first appeared as Ace Double F-173, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Jewels_of_Aptor)

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in the United States in 1962 (Ace Books). The edition's rights statement below says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin (United States): the text was first published in the United States in 1962 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Jewels_of_Aptor). The country of origin is therefore the United States, where the edition's rights statement says the text is public domain, so no other country's term applies.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
